title: OS Media Graph Export and VFS Window
description: Make every media resource in the OS media graph always exportable (2d→svg/png, 3d/5d→glb/obj), add outputExport flow nodes, and add a bidirectionally-editable VFS window mirroring the OS media graph.
summary: Implemented OS media graph export coverage (all 15 media resource kinds: 2d→svg/png, 3d/5d→glb/obj) via OsMediaExportRegistry + assertOsMediaExportCoverage; added outputExport flow widget (Rust/WASM + FlowCanvas + playground download); added bidirectional Media VFS window in S studio via OsMediaGraphVirtualFileSystemController synced through OsStore CQRS; extended VirtualFileSystemController with create/rename/delete/move CRUD and context-menu UI.
